Overall BiS.content:
Best in Slot Gear for Fire Mage
The best gear for Fire Mage just follows the stat priority. Many of the Raid slots are special, since they either have extra sockets (Ring & Neck) or all one stat. A strong on-use trinket is best paired with passive stat increase trinket.


Slot	Item	Source
Weapon	 Brazier of the Dissonant Dirge	Midnight Falls
Head	 Voidbreaker's Veil	Tier Set
Neck	 Amulet of the Abyssal Hymn	Midnight Falls
Shoulders	 Voidbreaker's Leyline Nexi	Tier Set
Cloak	 Adherent's Silken Shroud	Crafting
Chest	 Robes of Endless Oblivion	Midnight Falls
Wrist	 Martyr's Bindings	Crafting
Gloves	 Voidbreaker's Gloves	Tier Set
Belt	 Whisper-Inscribed Sash	Belo'ren
Legs	 Voidbreaker's Britches	Tier Set
Boots	 Lightbinder Treads	Skyreach
Ring	 Eye of Midnight	Midnight Falls
Ring	 Bond of Light	Lightblinded Vanguard
Trinket	 Emberwing Feather	Windrunner Spire
Trinket	 Locus-Walker's Ribbon	Crown of the Cosmos

At the start of the season, resources and gear are very limited, and the first few crafted pieces are crucial for progressing efficiently. Here is the best early crafting order for Fire Mage using  Spark of Radiance, targetting the quickest power gains:

The benefit is that a good weapon will go a long way towards increasing your damage, but there are risks associated with crafting before you have exhausted every option to get a weapon upgrade. Remember, the only way to be completely safe is to hold your Sparks. Once you have checked your Myth Great Vault, you can see whether or not you got a Myth Weapon! Early on, crafting for the biggest upgrade on your biggest budget slot is ideal.
Craft  Aln'hara Cane with  Darkmoon Sigil: Hunt  Explanation 
Craft  Martyr's Bindings (or Tier off-piece) with  Arcanoweave Lining  Explanation 
Craft  Adherent's Silken Shroud with  Arcanoweave Lining  Explanation 
Replace Low Item Level Pieces.
